title: 第五十章 操控第四十九章 线下碰面
slug: 魔头别夺舍了我们正道快没人了
lines: 接下来的路途上，两人未再过多闲谈。
林梦夕是有意留出时间，让季南北在路上调整状态，为即将到来的比斗做准备。
而季南北......
他干脆直接启动了寄魂，意识降临到小狐狸苏千雪那边，留下本体进入“托管”模式，自动赶路，智能应答。
“前辈，您来啦!”
季南北的意识甫一抵达，苏千雪便欢快地打着招呼。
季南北内视己身（小狐狸的身体），发现小狐狸目前的修为已然达到了练气三层，进境可谓相当迅速。炼天赋亦是不俗。
如此一来，季南北对于这只小狐狸的真实出身，倒是愈发好奇了。
“修炼进展不错，奖励你些好吃的。”
季南北从系统空间中，取出一株青翠欲滴的植物。
其形似含苞待放的花骨朵，顶端结着一颗尚未绽开的浑圆小球。
“前辈，这是何物呀?”
“一种灵物，味道甘美，对你的修行亦有益处。”
这是季南北先前完成讨伐任务时，偶然获得的四品灵物，名曰“糖灵草果”。
系统介绍称，此物滋味甜蜜，蕴含的灵气柔和易吸收，且多余的灵力会蕴灵物那般，未被及时吸收的部分便会溢散于天地间。
季南北得到此物后，便已打算留给苏千雪使用。
毕竟，寄魂期间，双方修为获取同步。
季南北亦可通过系统，将这部分增长的灵气同步至本体。
相当于白得了一份四品灵物的好处，相当划算。
将糖灵草果送入口中。
苏千雪立刻发出了满足的“唔唔“声。
“好甜呀!前辈您真好!”
小狐狸能有什么复杂心思呢?它只知道季南北是位“好前辈”。感受着纳入体内的柔和灵气缓缓流转，季南北满意地点了点头。
这部分灵气，足够小狐狸消化很长一段时间了。
此刻的小狐狸，自初次遇见季南北至今，也已辗转了许多山林。
练气三层的修为，搭配上近乎入门的“狐动九斩”，虽还不能在这妖兽繁多的山野之中纵横无忌，却也已具备了一定的自保之力。
“前辈，您知道哪里能找到人类吗?”
忽然，苏千雪如此问道。
这一问，让季南北也略感意外。
“怎么?你一只小狐狸，寻找人类做什么?”
季南北颇感奇怪地反问。“我想化形成人!听说化形成人后，修炼速度会更快些，还能去往人类的城池游玩!”
似乎觉得自己的表述不够清楚，苏千雪又补充道:
“前些时日修炼时，我脑海中忽然浮现了一道秘法，名曰‘讨封之法’。据说可向人类‘讨封’，借此机缘化形!”
季南北（操控狐狸身体）几不可察地扶额（如果狐狸有手的话）。
“讨封”这种颇为古怪的术法，居然真的存在?
而且，那不该是“黄大仙”（黄鼠狼）一脉的秘传吗?为何你一只小狐狸会获得这等传承啊?
关于“讨封秘法”，季南北也算是有所听闻。
此法乃是借取他人之气运功德，以助自身化形。
可谓是一种损人利己的偏门秘术。
content_en:
During the rest of the journey, the two of them didn't chat much.
Lin Mengxi deliberately left time for Ji Nanbei to adjust his condition on the road and prepare for the upcoming competition.
And Ji Nanbei...
He simply activated the Soul Retention, and his consciousness came to the little fox Su Qianxue, leaving the main body to enter the "hosting" mode, driving automatically and responding intelligently.
"Senior, you are here!"
As soon as Ji Nanbei's consciousness arrived, Su Qianxue greeted him cheerfully.
Ji Nanbei looked at his own body (the body of the little fox) and found that the little fox's current cultivation level had reached the third level of Qi training, and his progress could be said to be quite rapid. Refining talents is also a good idea.
As a result, Ji Nanbei became more and more curious about the true origin of this little fox.
"Your training is going well. I'll reward you with some delicious food."
Ji Nanbei took out a green plant from the system space.
It is shaped like a flower bud in bud, with a round ball that has not yet bloomed at the top.
"Senior, what is this?"
"A spiritual thing that tastes sweet and is also beneficial to your practice."
This is a fourth-grade spiritual object that Ji Nanbei accidentally obtained when he completed a previous crusade mission, called "Tangling Grass Fruit."
The system introduced that this thing has a sweet taste, and the spiritual energy it contains is soft and easy to absorb, and the excess spiritual power will be absorbed like a spiritual object, and the part that is not absorbed in time will overflow into the world.
After Ji Nanbei got this thing, he planned to leave it to Su Qianxue for use.
After all, during the soul transfer period, the cultivation levels of both parties are synchronized.
Ji Nanbei can also synchronize this part of the growing aura to his body through the system.
It is equivalent to getting the benefits of a fourth-grade spiritual item for free, which is quite a bargain.
Put the sugar spirit grass fruit into your mouth.
Su Qianxue immediately let out a satisfied "Hmm" sound.
"It's so sweet! You are so kind, senior!"
What complicated thoughts can a little fox have? It only knows that Ji Nanbei is a "good senior". Feeling the gentle spiritual energy flowing slowly inside his body, Ji Nanbei nodded with satisfaction.
This part of spiritual energy is enough for the little fox to digest for a long time.
The little fox now has traveled to many mountains and forests since he first met Ji Nanbei.
With the third level of Qi training, coupled with the almost entry-level "Fox Movement Nine Slashes", although he is not yet able to roam freely in the mountains and wilds with many monsters, he already has a certain ability to protect himself.
"Senior, do you know where to find humans?"
Suddenly, Su Qianxue asked.
Ji Nanbei was also slightly surprised by this question.
"What? What are you, a little fox, doing looking for humans?"
Ji Nanbei asked curiously. "I want to transform into a human being! I heard that after transforming into a human being, my cultivation speed will be faster, and I can also visit human cities!"
As if she felt that her statement was not clear enough, Su Qianxue added:
"When I was practicing some days ago, a secret method suddenly appeared in my mind, called the 'method of asking for a title'. It is said that you can 'ask for a title' from humans and take this opportunity to transform!"
Ji Nanbei (who controlled the fox's body) held his forehead almost imperceptibly (if the fox had hands).
Does the rather weird technique of "asking for a seal" really exist?
Moreover, shouldn't that be the secret inheritance of the "Wong Tai Sin" (weasel) lineage? Why did you, a little fox, get such an inheritance?
Ji Nanbei had also heard about the "secret method of seeking seals".
This method is to borrow the luck and merit of others to help oneself transform.
It can be said to be a side secret technique that benefits oneself at the expense of others.
